Projects

Each one is a working prototype you can open, and each one makes its reasoning visible.

ScoreVest

Investment research that cites its sources.

Moves from a market briefing to the sources, coverage and uncertainty behind a ticker's story. Sentiment, risk and return analytics sit next to the evidence, and simulations account for trading costs without letting future information leak into the past.

Built with
Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, SwiftUI
Shows
Source quality, confidence and evidence gaps
Status
iOS prototype with sample data; source private
Read the case study

DIANA

An AI workspace where nothing happens without review.

Keeps project context, source evidence, delegated reviews and approval checkpoints in one view, so you can see why a recommendation was made before you approve it. A companion workbench classifies sensitive text, redacts identifiers and issues a decision receipt.

Built with
React, Three.js, Rust and SQLite foundation
Shows
Provenance, approval holds and what still needs review
Status
Live demo with 8 fictional workflows; no live model
Open the live demo Try the privacy workbench

Perch

A pet fruit fly driven by a model of a real fly's brain.

Raise one fly over 50 days. Every reaction replays a recorded trial of a spiking model run on the mapped wiring of a real fly, and any reaction opens into a 3D view of the cells that fired. The specimen at the top of this page comes from the same data.

169,078neurons
3,542trials
3sister flies
23situations
Built with
JavaScript, three.js, Python, Numba
Shows
The path from a sense to a movement, cell by cell
